verdict.rationale: Firebase documents a MongoDB-compatible API for Cloud Firestore, so developers can use existing MongoDB drivers, tools and integrations against the database. That is a real standard-client path, but it is limited to the Firestore Enterprise edition, and the evidence never mentions a connection string or names ORM/ODM support. Missing for 10: explicit connection-string documentation, named ORM/ODM compatibility, availability outside the Enterprise edition, any SQL/Postgres-style wire access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
